goal: HIPAA safeguards check: access, audit and transmission safeguards for health information in code.
use: HIPAA safeguards check: access, audit and transmission safeguards for health information in code. Use when code stores or sends health information.

steps.note: Find the health information. List the fields and records that hold it.
Check access. Each access needs a role check and a record.
Check audit. Access and changes to health records must be logged.
Check transmission. Health information must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
Report. Each finding with file and line, the safeguard it breaks and the fix.
